_doc: Registered capabilities that shipped without a caller. Being here means the gap is KNOWN and its completion is TRACKED — it does not fail the gate. Remove an entry when the capability is wired (utilisation rises above threshold) or when its tracking ADR closes. A NEW orphan not listed here fails the audit: wire it or register it with a reason.

knowledge.system.reason: P2 APPLIED (2026-08-01): exposed + validated at the ingest API (payload `system`) and CLI (`ob_ingest --system`), required when a component:* identity is present. Historical rows pre-date the writer, so organic utilisation stays low; the capability is fully wired.

knowledge.valid_from (organic).reason: P5 APPLIED (2026-08-01): settable at the ingest API (payload `valid_from`), the CLI (`ob_ingest --valid-from`), and /api/ingest_state; write_knowledge also sets it as the retired predecessor's fact-offset (contiguous lifespans). 0 organic uses (valid_from<>created_at) is EXPECTED until a real backdating case occurs — wired, not dormant.

knowledge.valid_until.reason: P5 APPLIED: backdatable via supersession_events.fact_valid_until on all three retire paths (auto_supersede, ob2_state confirm, contradiction confirm); projection = COALESCE(fact_valid_until, occurred_at). Low organic backdating utilisation expected until a case occurs.

knowledge.supersedes_id.reason: legacy chain pointer; superseded by the P3 transition-record model — supersession_events is the source of truth for retirement. Retained on writes for back-compat; the event log, not this column, is authoritative.

knowledge.component_key(tag).reason: P2 APPLIED: promoted to a validated column with a writer on every write_knowledge INSERT (including /api/ingest_state after the 2026-08-01 rewire); retrieval reads the column. The freeform component:* tag remains only as a compatibility fallback.

cron.contradiction_detect (dormant).reason: P4 detection cron is built + routed (api/cron_contradiction_detect.py, app.py) but intentionally NOT scheduled in vercel.json — ~9 same-system candidate pairs today, almost all dismissable, so a nightly scan is over-built. Enable by adding one crons entry when volume climbs; detection also runs on demand via scripts/contradiction_review.py.
